goal.mission: An imprecise coded-dash interceptor hits a moving target flying >=9 m/s (20 mph), outdoors, camera-only markerless terminal (no datalink; AprilTag sanctioned for calibration/training-labels and as the staged first-kill baseline seeker, never the deployed markerless seeker's input).
goal.success: BINARY KILL (contact), confirmed by seeker video + phone slow-mo + both aircraft ULogs. NOT a measured <1 m CPA (RTK cut, 2026-07-15). Sim proxy metric: Pk@2.5 m proximity kill (ADR-0025).

headline.text: THE BINDING WALL (5th mirage corrected, ADR-0076 add #18k): the markerless detector is NOT blind — controlled set-pose sweep scores 100% recall static/centred at 8-22 m on BOTH approach and receding aspects, yet 0.8% IN FLIGHT. The wall is FLIGHT-DYNAMIC: the ~40 deg nose-down dash pitch parks the target at the frame-top edge (~41 deg off-axis) where training never showed it. Corrected levers: (1) POINTING/attitude is dominant (adaptive tilt #46/ADR-0065); (2) real-data detector DEMOTED to hypothesis (matters for the outdoor appearance gap, not the sim wall). Resolution/foveated-crop is NOT a lever (add #18j-fix). #1 unmeasured: recall vs POSITION-IN-FRAME and bank attitude (not range).
headline.next_probe: Re-run the set-pose sweep at the frame-top off-axis position x {level, banked} attitudes — decomposes pointing/attitude/edge-clip and specs what a real capture must contain. Cheap, offline-scoreable (tilt-aware gt chain exists, add #18k(2)).

stages.name: Launch & open-loop aim
stages.active: Auto collision-lead heading from pre-flight target kinematics (honest constant, no live gt); --dash-heading-deg override ('human points it').
stages.note: Aim tolerance measured: all 48 flights still acquired/engaged at up to +/-30 deg heading error (weave) — but #18g showed ENGAGE streaks can be phantom, so read that as dash-robustness, not perception proof. Onboard acoustic tracking REJECTED (own-noise ~40 dB the wrong way); acoustics OK only as a future GROUND launch-cue (idea).

changelog.note: Onboard acoustics ruled DEAD; ground launch-cue remains an idea.

stages.name: Coded open-loop dash
stages.active: --coded-dash + --dash-crossing-bias-deg (per-direction aim bias auto-keyed on crossing direction); dash-speed 16; cue/FusedTrack/handoff-gate/coast-search stack DROPPED (real hardware has no cue).
stages.note: VALIDATED in sim: the architecture A/B beat the cue-guided config on r2l (ADR-0076 add #18), and the crossing-bias is a real open-loop AIM calibration — r2l dash ballistics land ~0.3-0.5 m CPA on line@9. Beware: those dash ballistics are so good they created the mirages (sub-meter CPAs with zero camera guidance). Bias magnitude is speed/aspect-specific — re-tune on real data.

changelog.note: #18g retraction: crossing-bias survives as OPEN-LOOP AIM only — 'camera-guided sub-meter' claims retracted.

stages.name: Markerless seeker (NN detector)
stages.active: drone_finetuned_quad_v2.onnx @640, conf 0.25 (v3 and rebal are closed NULLs — do NOT resurrect). Static acquisition ceiling ~24 m (conf 0.25, 640 full-frame).
stages.note: THE BINDING WALL: 100% recall static/centred 8-22 m BOTH aspects, but 0.8% in flight — a FLIGHT-DYNAMIC deficit (off-boresight frame-top placement under dash pitch), NOT appearance/resolution/range. Conf-threshold lowering NULL (phantom rate doubles). The sweep's featureless-grey world makes 100% a CEILING — real clutter is strictly harder.

changelog.note: approach_recall.py: in-flight approach recall 0.8% >=8 m (the wall quantified).
Set-pose sweep: static wall DOES NOT EXIST (100% @8-22 m both aspects) — wall reframed flight-dynamic (5th mirage corrected).

stages.name: Camera pointing / adaptive tilt
stages.active: Adaptive gimbal #46 BUILT (committed 8657320, default-off, own-state-only controller + live derotation); tilt-aware gt chain exists (INTERCEPTOR_SENSOR_PITCH_RAD, add #18k(2)). No tilt is adopted in the deployed config.
stages.note: Now the DOMINANT lever for the wall: dash pitch swings ~40 deg down (accelerating) to ~34 deg up (terminal brake), so a FIXED tilt only relocates the in-view window (fixed +15 adoption FAILED Stage-1 parity, ADR-0068; +35 capture was INVALID — 4th mirage). Adaptive tilt is NOT yet validated as the wall fix — that A/B is the open build.

changelog.note: Fixed up15 mount: mechanism confirmed but NO adoption (terminal cost).
Pointing mechanism MEASURED (target at frame top, ~+41 deg off-axis at 11 m); adaptive tilt promoted to dominant lever; gt chain made tilt-aware.

stages.name: Acquisition & handoff
stages.active: 5-consecutive-fresh-detections streak hands the dash to the camera terminal. Planned hardening (unbuilt): streak range-consistency + pre-flight range-plausibility window.
stages.note: OPEN HAZARD: the own-prop PHANTOM (reads ~1.5 m) can seed a false handoff — it is the false-handoff hazard, NOT the acquisition blocker (add #18g corrected this). Every software separator is NULL: ADR-0077 range gate, --coded-dash-acquire-range-* gate (phantom and usable detections overlap), rebal retrain, ~12 prior levers. Only mitigation: HARDWARE prop-clearance (no software fallback) + handoff hardening.

changelog.note: ADR-0077 range gate flown: NULL (l2r regressed 81%->25%).
#18g: phantom re-scoped from acquisition-blocker to false-handoff hazard.

stages.name: Pro-nav camera-only terminal
stages.active: flight/ portable core (geometry LOS-derotation FIX-A + alpha-beta estimator + pro-nav N=5 + Brown-Conrady undistortion), 25 tests, no gz/gt/cue imports — runs unchanged on the real Pi/Pixhawk.
stages.note: The guidance LAW and ARCHITECTURE are validated (billboard target: Pk@2.8 m 72/72, ADR-0064; AprilTag regimes M4+). But the camera-guided terminal kill of the 3D QUAD is NOT validated: the 'sub-meter kills' were open-loop dash ballistics MIRAGES (dash-only control matched with-terminal, 0.30 vs 0.29 m; camera added ~nothing). Blocked by detector+pointing upstream, not by guidance.

changelog.note: flight/ core extracted + wired (byte-identical); m4 coded-dash aim calls flight.guidance.
#18h final sim verdict: no camera-guided 3D-quad intercept achievable in this sim — a detector problem, not guidance or mount.

stages.name: Kill & scoring
stages.active: Sim: Pk@2.5 m proximity metric (ADR-0025), CPA from gt (scoring only). Real: BINARY KILL evidence = seeker video + phone slow-mo + both ULogs ($0).
stages.note: Criterion re-scoped 2026-07-15 from measured <1 m CPA to binary kill — this is what cut the RTK pair from the BOM. field_score.py (CPA from dual GPS logs) is planned, not built; consumer GPS cannot measure <1 m anyway.

changelog.note: Binary-kill re-scope adopted; RTK cut (~$220-300 saved).

stages.name: Real-data capture -> retrain pipeline
stages.active: autolabel_from_apriltag.py (tag pose -> auto YOLO labels, hardened: tag-miss frames dropped, negatives only from target-free footage) + calibrate_camera.py + approach_recall.py. Retrain recipe: COCO-init (never sim weights), ~15-20% negatives, validate on held-out FLIGHTS.
stages.note: Built but only PARTIALLY validated (box-width check was circular; the tag-box-vs-gt-box IoU-vs-range validation in the apriltag world has NOT run). DEMOTED to a HYPOTHESIS for the sim wall (add #18k): a static/hover capture would ace static tests and still fail in flight (the v3/rebal trap). Real value = the OUTDOOR appearance gap. Any capture MUST include approaching passes at speed, off-boresight/frame-edge placements, banked attitudes — scored vs position-in-frame, not just range.

changelog.note: Pipeline built + Fable-hardened; demoted from critical-path-certain to hypothesis by the set-pose sweep.

stages.active: Lean binary-kill BOM: interceptor ~$740, everything-new ~$1,390 (~$1,080 if TX/charger/tools owned). Pi 5 8GB; OV9281 mono global-shutter wide (verify >=100 deg HFOV; AR0234 = upgrade path); Hailo AI HAT+ DEFERRED; nose-cantilever prop-clearance mount = HARD bench gate; RTK cut; Remote ID = legal line item.
stages.note: Nothing ordered yet (builder decision pending). COMPUTE CONSTRAINT: Pi 5 CPU runs the AprilTag baseline real-time, but markerless YOLO REQUIRES the deferred Hailo HAT (CPU ~5-10 FPS not viable at terminal LOS rates) — so first kills fly the TAG. PRE-BUILD kill-or-validate: ~$310 tripod + tagged-target afternoon measuring real approach-recall-vs-range BEFORE building (the outdoor-NN transfer bet is hope-past-evidence). NOTE: BOM §0⑥ ('acquisition range bought in software first / foveated crop') is STALE — contradicted by add #18j-fix.

changelog.note: Pre-purchase audit fixes + binary-kill cost-cut: ~$1,390 lean, RTK/HAT/SiK deferred or cut.

stages.name: Sim testbed & evidence machine
stages.active: PX4 v1.17 SITL + Gazebo Harmonic headless, x500 mono cam (1280x960, ~100 deg), 3D quad target models/fpv_quad_enemy (billboard retired for realism work), mc_batch paired-seed methodology, GPU render ON (ADR-0075, RTF ~0.95).
stages.note: The sim STAYS (ADR-0072 — no pivot; a pivot invalidates ~70 measured ADRs). Honesty boundary enforced: gt_* is scoring/logging only. Methodology that caught all five mirages lives here: paired seeds n>=8, control arms, gt-consistent ENGAGE audits, statistics before verdicts.

changelog.note: GPU render adopted (RTF 0.336->0.951); 3D quad target replaces billboard for realism work.

constraints.text: Pi 5 CPU runs the AprilTag baseline seeker real-time; markerless YOLO REQUIRES the (deferred) Hailo AI HAT+ — CPU YOLO ~5-10 FPS is not viable at terminal LOS rates. First real kills therefore fly the tag.
The ~100 deg wide FoV is a HARD requirement, not a tunable — the +/-30 deg open-loop aim tolerance depends on it. Never fit/fly a narrow lens.

The own-prop phantom has NO software fallback (phantom-free retrain fails blind in flight; every gate NULL). Prop clearance must be designed in by geometry (nose-cantilever mount) and verified by the bench corner-spin check — a HARD gate.
No guidance datalink (the jam-resistance story): the dash is open-loop, ELRS is kill/arm only, SiK is telemetry-monitoring only. Nothing mid-course steers the interceptor except its own camera.

gt_* is scoring/logging ONLY; guidance sees camera + own-state EKF only. AprilTag is sanctioned for calibration, training-time auto-labels, and the staged baseline seeker — never as an input to the deployed markerless seeker.

The MIT-licensed outdoor-drone-NN transfer bet is UNVALIDATED (hope past evidence). Cheapest kill-or-validate: ~$310 tripod + tagged-target afternoon measuring real approach-recall vs range/frame-position BEFORE building the interceptor.

FIVE mirages were caught in the coded-dash arc alone (rebal 16/16, camera-guided r2l, resolution probe, up35 capture, static-aspect wall). Any new 'win' needs a control arm (dash-only / gt-consistent audit), paired seeds n>=8, and validation on held-out FLIGHTS — never frame-eval or single-seed.
Success criterion is a BINARY KILL confirmed on video + both ULogs; a citable sub-meter CPA number is explicitly NOT required (RTK cut — buy later only for a portfolio number).

graveyard.why: Own-prop noise ~40 dB the wrong way. (Ground launch-cue variant stays an idea.)

graveyard.what: Resolution / foveated-crop as the wall lever
graveyard.why: Crop = full-frame recall at the 8-12 m wall band; the earlier '47->71%' was edge-clipped close targets (3rd mirage).
Both NULL: ace frame-eval, fail in flight (v3 regressed all 10 held-out flights; rebal flies blind, 0/16 acquisitions). Do not resurrect.
ADR-0077 gate regressed l2r 81%->25%; --coded-dash-acquire-range-* aborted both directions. Range does not separate phantom from usable detections.
NULL at n=31 (the n=8 'win' was noise); kept default-off.
Kinematic floor + SNR<1 noise wall; even clean-bearing AprilTag floors ~1.64 m at 12 m/s weave.
Stage-1 parity FAIL (worse 7/8 compensated); a fixed tilt only relocates the in-view window under the swinging dash pitch.
Invalidates the whole measured evidence base; both realism complaints were fixable in Gazebo.
Cut by the binary-kill re-scope; buy later only if a citable sub-meter number is wanted.

graveyard.what: Literal <1 m markerless @9 m/s as the headline goal
graveyard.why: Pre-registered R1 rule fired (line@9 median 3.38 m); reframed to speed ladder + binary kill.

graveyard.what: AprilTag as the terminal seeker in a crossing dash
graveyard.why: The directional ~6 m tag is invisible during a 16 m/s crossing dash (0 detections) — worse than the NN there. (Tag stays the staged first-kill baseline in the easy straight-leg regime.)
Re-creates the fast-crosser-walks-out-of-frame failure; wide FoV is a hard requirement.
